Lh2ZKwPV_wjl8ljihdHezA.zh: 辛巴威疫情上升,今年迄今累計126,229例病例,較去年同期31,813例上升296.8%,以該國東北部中馬紹納蘭省49,944例最多,其次為該國東部馬卡蘭省27,398例;今年迄今累計358例死亡(CFR 0.3%),較去年同期59例死亡上升506.8%。非洲南部之波札那、史瓦帝、納米比亞等國疫情亦上升。
Lh2ZKwPV_wjl8ljihdHezA.en: Malaria is rising in Zimbabwe. So far this year, 126,229 cases have been reported, up 296.8% from 31,813 in the same period last year. Mashonaland Central Province in the northeast accounts for the most, with 49,944 cases, followed by Manicaland Province in the east with 27,398 cases. So far this year, 358 deaths have been reported (CFR 0.3%), up 506.8% from 59 deaths in the same period last year. Malaria has also increased in the southern African countries of Botswana, Eswatini and Namibia.
